title: 第12章 经典就是经典！
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
经过数月的努力，维托里奥库尼伯蒂男爵终于在鲁普雷希特的启发和鼓励下（主要是金钱）把历史上那一款声名远扬的战舰搞出来了！加里波第级，好吧，现在被称为慕尼黑级装甲巡洋舰闪亮登场！而当新晋升的男爵拿着自己的设计图兴冲冲的跑过来打算和老板讨论一下今年的奖金问题的时候，王子殿下的表示很不满！倒不是说心疼那点钱。而是说，这个设计和历史上变化不大啊！自己花了好几天的时间来给他灌输后世的先进理念，怎么到最后还搞出一个加强版加里波第？
要说变化的话还是有的，原版加里波第混乱的主炮搭载方式被统一弄成了单装11寸炮。为了适应远洋作战，加里波第原型舰的排水量被提高到7200吨。锅炉系统还是在水管和火管锅炉之间纠结。侧弦的6寸和4。7寸炮的混合搭配被改成了统一的150MM速射炮。然后，然后这就完了..。装甲防护和动力输出几乎没有改变，隔舱数量增加了一些。
“因循守旧啊。”王子殿下很不高兴，自己想要的双联装240MM火炮没有出现，210MM双联装二级主炮也没出现，排水量和自己预期的万吨标准差距巨大，慕尼黑级装甲巡洋舰的战斗力上限依然和历史上差不多。和自己心目中留里克2或者PISA级别的战斗力差距太大了。“7000吨级装甲巡洋舰战斗力十分有限，不足以压制未来10年内出现的装甲巡洋舰。而且2级主炮代表了先进战斗力的发展方向，怎么你就不懂呢？”
“您的想法确实代表了未来海军的发展方向，确实有很多独到的地方。确实是一款强大的战舰！但是，他绝对不是一款适合现在德国的装甲巡洋舰，如果您是英国的皇子的话，倒是可以建议设计师们按照您的想法设计这样一艘战舰。”男爵先生颇为诚恳的说道。
“您设计战舰的目的到底是为了什么？”男爵先生问道。
“当然是压倒目前所有的巡洋舰，我们有最好的装甲，加上良好的设计完全可以实现这个目标！”王子殿下脱口而出！如果不能弄一款足够强悍的战舰，这样的穿越者和咸鱼有什么区别？！
“错了！大错特错！您设计战舰的目的是要中标！至于这艘战舰需要对抗什么的目标，那是海军部老爷们的意思！我们只是设计师，没必要越俎代庖！也许我们的敌人只是法国人的巡洋舰。而您非要弄一艘足够匹敌英国一等巡洋舰布莱克的战舰，那就是浪费！海军部不会因为您的设计优秀而多花一个马克！因为他们不需要？”男爵痛心疾首的说道。自己的老板怎么就不能摆对您的位置呢？您现在是个商人，不是王子，也不能做海军部那些家伙的主！
“我去，您干销售绝对是一把手！”鲁普雷希特的话语中充满了敬佩，这哥们人才啊，技术销售两手抓两手都要硬啊！
“所以，我们的设计绝对不能吓倒那些老爷们！德意志帝国造过的最大的巡洋舰不超过5000吨，您直接拿出一个10000吨的方案，他们会怎么想？他们的钱包会怎么想？您考虑过他们心脏的承受力吗？顾客就是上帝！我们要顺应他们的思想啊。”男爵的谆谆教诲在耳边响起。
虽然很不舒服，但是王子不得不承认，男爵说的非常有道理，加里波第要是真的造的和PISA一个级别的话，阿根廷能一下买4艘？日本的万吨装甲巡洋舰的造价和当初的富士相比只高不低！后世的留里克2的造价高达140万英镑以上！即使自己的船便宜点，100万英镑估计也很难拿下来。这个价格对于目前德国海军的预算来说是很难承受的，而且为了保证远洋始终有足够堪用的战舰，数量是必须保持的！这也能解释为何历史上条约期的时候，英国人的轻巡洋舰总吨位超过重巡洋舰吨位。
德国海军要更新它的巡洋舰舰队，数量肯定是要保证的，尤其是在内部消息传出来说帝国宰相将巡洋舰队的发展放到了海军发展的首要位置上后，那么这个数量绝对不少，至少也要在4艘以上吧。既然如此，单舰造价肯定不能过高。而自己的要求显然超出了德国海军的承受能力。按照目前的估计，一艘战舰连火炮造价在65万英镑左右应该是一个合适的价位。而加里波第几乎就在这个价格区间。男爵的想法非常好！

content_en:
After months of hard work, Baron Vittorio Cuniberti finally, with Ruprecht's inspiration and encouragement (mainly money), created the most famous battleship in history! The Garibaldi class, well now known as the Munich class armored cruiser makes its debut! And when the newly promoted Baron came over excitedly with his design drawings and planned to discuss this year's bonus with his boss, His Royal Highness the Prince expressed dissatisfaction! It's not that I feel bad about the money. Rather, this design has not changed much from history! I spent several days instilling in him the advanced concepts of later generations, how could I end up with an enhanced version of Garibaldi?
There are still some changes. The chaotic main gun mounting method of the original Garibaldi has been unified into a single 11-inch gun. In order to adapt to ocean operations, the displacement of the Garibaldi prototype ship was increased to 7,200 tons. Boiler systems are still torn between water tube and fire tube boilers. The mix of 6-inch and 4.7-inch guns on the side string was changed to a unified 150MM rapid-fire gun. And then, and then it's over... The armor protection and power output are almost unchanged, and the number of compartments has been increased.
"Standing to the old ways." His Highness the Prince was very unhappy. The twin-mounted 240MM artillery he wanted did not appear, and the 210MM twin-mounted secondary main gun did not appear. The displacement was hugely different from the 10,000-ton standard he expected. The upper limit of the combat effectiveness of the Munich-class armored cruiser was still similar to that in history. There is a huge gap between the combat effectiveness of Rurik 2 or PISA level in my mind. "The combat effectiveness of the 7,000-ton armored cruiser is very limited and is not enough to suppress the armored cruisers that will appear in the next 10 years. Moreover, the level 2 main gun represents the development direction of advanced combat effectiveness. Why don't you understand?"
"Your idea does represent the development direction of the future navy, and it does have many unique features. It is indeed a powerful battleship! However, it is definitely not an armored cruiser suitable for Germany today. If you are a British prince, you can suggest designers to design such a battleship according to your ideas." Mr. Baron said sincerely.
"What is your purpose in designing a battleship?" Mr. Baron asked.
"Of course it is overwhelming all the current cruisers. We have the best armor and good design to achieve this goal!" His Highness the Prince blurted out! If you can't get a powerful enough battleship, what's the difference between such a time traveler and a salted fish? !
"Wrong! Big mistake! Your purpose in designing a battleship is to win the bid! As for what targets this battleship needs to fight against, that's what the men of the Navy want! We are just designers, there is no need to overstep the mark! Maybe our enemy is just France. A human cruiser. And if you insist on building a battleship that can rival the British first-class cruiser Blake, it is a waste! The Admiralty will not spend an extra mark because of your excellent design!" the baron said sadly. Why can't your boss put you in the right position? You are now a businessman, not a prince, and you cannot be the boss of those guys in the Admiralty!
"Let me go, you are definitely the number one in sales!" Ruprecht's words were full of admiration. This guy is so talented. He can handle both technical sales and sales!
"So, our design must not scare those gentlemen! The largest cruiser ever built by the German Empire does not exceed 5,000 tons. If you come up with a 10,000-ton plan, what will they think? What will their wallets think? Have you considered the endurance of their hearts? Customers are God! We must comply with their thoughts." The baron's earnest instructions rang in my ears.
Although it was very uncomfortable, the prince had to admit that what the baron said was very reasonable. GaribaldSecondly, if they are really built to the same level as PISA, can Argentina buy 4 ships at once? The cost of building Japan's 10,000-ton armored cruiser is only higher than that of the original Fuji! The later Rurik 2 cost more than 1.4 million pounds! Even if your own boat is cheaper, it is estimated that it will be difficult to get 1 million pounds. This price is unaffordable for the current budget of the German Navy, and in order to ensure that there are always enough usable warships in the ocean, the number must be maintained! This can also explain why during the period of the treaty in history, the total tonnage of the British light cruisers exceeded the tonnage of heavy cruisers.
If the German Navy wants to update its cruiser fleet, the number must be guaranteed, especially after internal news comes out that the Imperial Chancellor has put the development of the cruiser fleet at the top of the naval development, then this number is definitely a lot, at least 4 ships or more. In this case, the cost of building a single ship must not be too high. And his own requirements are obviously beyond the capabilities of the German Navy. According to current estimates, the cost of a battleship and its artillery should be around 650,000 pounds, which should be a suitable price. And Garibaldi is almost in this price range. Baron's idea is very good!
